content.value_statement: Gemini API development requires current model, SDK, and documentation guidance. This skill helps Claude, Codex, and Claude Code build reliable Gemini integrations.
actual_capabilities: Identifies current Gemini model families and their intended uses.
Shows setup guidance for Python, JavaScript, TypeScript, and Go SDKs.
Provides quick start examples for basic text generation requests.
Points to official REST discovery specs for schema and method details.
Links to official documentation for function calling, structured output, embeddings, and multimodal use.
limitations: It does not contain executable helper scripts or automated project scaffolding.
It depends on external Google documentation for the latest API details.
It does not validate API keys, quotas, billing, or account permissions.
Model names and documentation links may change after the skill is published.

use_cases.title: Prototype Gemini Features
use_cases.description: Use model and SDK guidance to add Gemini text, image, or structured output features to an app.

use_cases.title: Plan API Migration
use_cases.description: Compare current SDK names with legacy package names before updating Gemini API integrations.

use_cases.title: Find Official References
use_cases.description: Locate official Gemini docs and REST discovery specs before implementing advanced API calls.

prompt_templates.title: Choose a Model
prompt_templates.prompt: Use the Gemini API skill to recommend a Gemini model for my app. My app needs [latency], [input types], and [output needs].

prompt_templates.title: Create a Quick Start
prompt_templates.prompt: Use the Gemini API skill to outline a first Gemini API request for [Python or TypeScript]. Include setup steps and key SDK objects.

prompt_templates.title: Design Function Calling
prompt_templates.prompt: Use the Gemini API skill to plan function calling for [use case]. List required functions, input fields, and validation concerns.

prompt_templates.title: Verify API Details
prompt_templates.prompt: Use the Gemini API skill to check the official discovery spec for [method or feature]. Summarize parameters, response shape, and migration risks.

output_examples.input: I need a Gemini model for fast multimodal support in a chat product.
output_examples.output: Recommendation with the likely model family, latency tradeoffs, SDK choice, and documentation pages to verify before implementation.

output_examples.input: I am migrating from an older Gemini SDK to the current JavaScript SDK.
output_examples.output: Migration checklist covering package names, client creation, request structure, documentation links, and tests to run after the update.

output_examples.input: I want structured output for a content classification workflow.
output_examples.output: Implementation plan describing schema design, validation steps, model selection, fallback handling, and official reference pages.

best_practices: Check the official discovery spec before relying on field names or method behavior.
Pin SDK versions in production projects and review migration guides before upgrades.
Validate structured outputs and function call arguments before using them in application logic.
anti_patterns: Do not assume model names stay current without checking official documentation.
Do not expose API keys in prompts, client logs, examples, or repository files.
Do not execute model-generated function calls without validation and authorization checks.

faq.question: Does this skill call the Gemini API directly?
faq.answer: No. It provides guidance and documentation references for building Gemini API integrations.

faq.question: Which tools can use this skill?
faq.answer: The report lists support for Claude, Codex, and Claude Code.

faq.question: Does it include SDK installation guidance?
faq.answer: Yes. It names current SDK packages for Python, JavaScript, TypeScript, and Go.

faq.question: Can it help with function calling?
faq.answer: Yes. It points to official function calling documentation and helps plan tool definitions.

faq.question: Can it guarantee current Gemini model names?
faq.answer: No. It recommends checking official Google documentation because model availability can change.

faq.question: Is this skill safe to install automatically?
faq.answer: The audit found documentation-only content with no executable skill code. Final install policy is computed by the marketplace.
